hypothesis: Energy dependence of the diagonal second-order attachment self-energy measurably changes the Yb+ spectrum relative to on-shell addition, without changing the core or orbital space.
fixed_conditions: Retained Z70 Fermi V68 closed core, same ns123/R60 native radial metric, same five external normalized DF valence spinors, all 19 core orbitals; Dirac-Coulomb only.
primary_space: Complete l<=6 virtual kappa blocks, all bound and positive-energy virtuals below 50 Ha; no active root count truncation.
tail_control: Derive l<=4 by exact filtering of the retained pole expansion against original virtual kappa identities; additionally split 0-5, 5-20 and 20-50 Ha contribution groups. No small-coupling pruning.
distinguishing_outcomes: Compare individual attachment shifts, excitation residuals, and l4-to-l6 increments with and without scalar Dyson solving. A numerical root pass is separate from experimental or spatial convergence.
branch: Solve E=epsilon_DF+Sigma2(E) on a pole-free interval containing epsilon_DF; select the branch connected to the DF root as coupling goes to zero. Do not select a satellite root by experimental proximity.
initial_bracket_Ha: [epsilon_DF-0.1, epsilon_DF]; reject any nonzero-weight pole in the bracket and reject a bracket without a root. No tuning to experimental energies.
scope: Diagonal frozen-orbital Dyson energy dependence only; no off-diagonal Brueckner orbital relaxation, self-consistent GF2, vertex corrections, QED, Breit, RPA, or correlated radiative rates.

gates.one_pole_analytic_Hermitian_control: Dyson energy and residue match a 2x2 Hermitian Hamiltonian eigenvalue and eigenvector weight

resources.cap_change_reason: Exact nonzero pole/weight storage, physical group metadata and replay checks add work; no change to physical space.

stopping_condition: Stop after full-space capture, matched on-shell replay, all five Dyson roots and l4/l6 controls; preserve failures and do not claim radial, higher-order, radiative, or precision convergence.
